leadText:
Nanette (Japanese: ノノミ Nonomi) is a character of the day who appeared in New Places... Familiar Faces!. She is a new just starting out on her Pokémon journey and was on her way to Nuvema Town to get her first partner Pokémon from Professor Juniper. She is very anxious and fears that everything will turn out worse than the reality.

 and met her as she was having trouble crossing over a bridge. They crossed ahead of her, reassuring her that the bridge was safe. Later, when she arrived at the lab, she refused to go inside, fearing it was full of hostile and instead called out to anyone inside. She met with Ash and his friends again who invited her inside, and again she panicked, fearing Professor Juniper would be cruel to her. Instead, the Professor greeted her with a smile, and released , , and so she could choose one as her first partner Pokémon. The selection of first partner Pokémon began to make Nanette worried that if she chose Snivy, it would evolve in her sleep and constrict her in affection as a . She ruled out Oshawott as well, as she worried that it might accidentally her in her sleep. So, Nanette decided, thanks to 's advice, to choose Tepig as her first partner Pokémon.

Ash and his friends decided to help Nanette bond with Tepig through a Tag Battle. She initially told Tepig to use after Ash commanded Pikachu to do so, which confused it. Ash reminded her that Tepig is a Fire-type and thus can't use Thunderbolt and to look up its moves in her Pokédex. The battle was soon interrupted when appeared in one of their mechas. In a panic, Nanette quickly returned Tepig to its as the other Pokémon were stunned by 's . Team Rocket nearly managed to steal Pikachu, but Nanette was able to distract Team Rocket with Tepig, who ended up being captured instead. Ash sent and to rescue Tepig, and it was eventually returned to Nanette who set off on her own journey.
